title: Sopa Azteca
subtitle: Mexican tortilla soup with shredded chicken and avocado
excerpt: Sopa azteca is a smoky, deeply flavoured Mexican soup of blended tomatoes and chilli with shredded chicken and crispy tortilla strips. The contrast of the crisp strips softening in the hot broth as you eat is what makes it special. Avocado and fresh coriander go on top.
sourceNotes: Sopa azteca, also called sopa de tortilla or tortilla soup, is a traditional Mexican dish thought to originate in the state of Tlaxcala. It was likely developed as a way to use stale tortillas, which crisp up beautifully when fried.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The broth can be made 2 days ahead. Fry the tortilla strips and prepare the toppings fresh.

content.text: For the tortilla strips, cut corn tortillas or a thin plain flatbread into narrow strips about 1cm wide. Fry in 1cm of hot sunflower oil in a small pan for 2 to 3 minutes per batch, turning once, until golden and crisp. Drain on kitchen paper and season with salt immediately.

items.prepNote: poached in salted water and shredded

content.text: Poach the chicken breasts in salted simmering water for 15 minutes until cooked through. Lift out, cool slightly and shred into strips with two forks. Reserve 500ml of the poaching liquid.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pot over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, chilli and cumin and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tinned tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Transfer to a blender and blitz until very smooth.
Return the blended tomato mixture to the pot. Pour in the chicken stock and the reserved poaching liquid. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Taste and season.
Fry the tortilla strips as described in the intro note. Drain and season.
Divide the shredded chicken between four warm bowls. Ladle over the hot broth. Top with avocado, a handful of tortilla strips, fresh coriander and a wedge of lime.

items.cause: Not enough tomato or not reduced enough.
items.fix: Simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes to reduce.

items.cause: Added to the soup too early.
items.fix: Serve them on the side and let each person add their own.
